Those boundary cases feel calm and clear. The empty state explains how to begin, unreadable pages can still be saved with details I provide, invalid text gets a helpful message, and long titles wrap without disrupting the cards.

Newest-first is the right default, but I do want sorting to be part of the app rather than only a later possibility. I’d like to switch between newest added, oldest added, and alphabetical by title, and remember my preferred default.

Treating good performance with hundreds of links as a goal during the real build is agreeable.
